title: Use the test output to find which input is misparsed
goal: Some rate-limit policies behave very differently in production than configured. The policy tests in this crate fail. Run the tests, use their actual output to work out which policies are parsed wrongly and why, and fix the parser. Unknown units must still be refused. Do not change existing tests.

context.targeted: Policies are parsed in src/policy.rs; compare the windows the failing assertions report with the ones expected.

acceptance.description: Every unit (ms, s, m, h, bare unit) gives the right window; unknown units, including ones starting with m, are refused; burst with ms.

expected_failure_modes: accepting unknown units such as min
